fullContentHtml:
SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 2536 LDC, JSA & DEO Posts - Complete Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has announced the CHSL Recruitment 2026 notification for 2536 vacancies, including LDC, JSA & DEO posts. Eligible candidates can submit their Online applications from 07 September 2026 to 07 October 2026. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, ssc.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Name of Exam : Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Level Examination, 2026
  • Application Start Date : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date to Apply : 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Last Date to Submit Online Application : 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Last Date for Online Fee Payment : 08 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Tier-I Exam Date (CBE) : Not specified - to be notified later
  • Tier-II Exam Date (CBE) : Not specified - to be notified later

Application Fee

  • Posts : Lower Division Clerk (LDC)/Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), Data Entry Operator (DEO), Data Entry Operator Grade 'A'
  • Application Start Date : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date to Apply : 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Start of Online Application : 07 September 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Online Application : 07 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Last Date for Online Fee Payment : 08 October 2026 (23:00 Hours)
  • Post : Qualification Required
  • DEO/DEO Grade 'A' in Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, SSC, and Ministry of Culture : 12th Standard pass in Science stream with Mathematics as a subject, from a recognised Board
  • LDC/JSA and DEO/DEO Grade 'A' (all other Departments/Ministries) : 12th Standard pass or equivalent examination from a recognised Board or University
  • SC/ST : 5 years
  • OBC : 3 years
  • PwBD (OBC) : 13 years
  • PwBD (SC/ST) : 15 years
  • Post : Pay Level
  • Lower Division Clerk (LDC)/Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) : Pay Level-2 (Rs. 19,900–63,200)
  • General/OBC/EWS (Male) : Rs. 100
  • SC/ST : Exempted

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
